_note: Generic Greek base (BASE_07), single-language Hellenic seeded directly from culture_achillean.json (kept separately). Hellenic sub-palette of the Classical family: the polis and the archon, basileus, pitch-accent register; -os/-on/-es endings, aspirates th/ph/kh, patronymic -id-. As a BASE there is no blend and no fusion_rules - one Greek tongue, not a synthesis. Common-word lexicon and rank titles use the Hellenic register (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are phoneme-morphs of the Agrippan canon through Hellenic phonology, never real Greek gods. All human cultures allow Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic. Ruler/domain DISPLAY titles are English (or an approved commonly-known foreign term: Archon for county); conlang titles live in ruler_native/domain_native for NPC dialogue. Polis/republican institutions (Boule, Ekklesia) are narrative flavor only; mechanically Hellaspol is a feudal realm.

phonology.palette: Hellenic: a e i o u + long e/o; aspirates th/ph/kh; endings -os/-on/-es/-eus/-e; s, l, r, n.
phonology.phonotactics: CV / CVC; clusters kt/pt/st/ph/th/kh/ps; -os/-on common; vowel-final frequent.

morphology.patronymic_form: patronymic suffix -ides / -ades (son of); plus deme/polis demonym of origin.
morphology.compounding_rule: [adjective|resource](stem) + feature-word with linking -o-: melas + oros -> Melanoros; or Nea + Polis -> Neapolis.

title_ladder.government: feudal (a Hellenic feudal monarchy; the basileus at the crown over the eparch-counties and the toparch-baronies; the polis/republican forms - Boule, Ekklesia - are aesthetic flavor, not modeled)
title_ladder._tiers_note: English display ladder, ascending (barony, march, county, duchy, principality, kingdom, empire), with the Hellenic conlang co-titles beneath in *_native. County ruler shows as the approved foreign term Archon. Native: Toparch/Toparchy barony; Phrourarch/Phrourarchia march (a garrison command); Eparch/Eparchy county; Strategos/Strategia duchy; Dynastes/Dynasteia principality; Basileus/Basileia kingdom; Autokrator/Autokratoria empire. -arch/-archy rhyme the lower native tiers; Basileus/Basileia and Autokrator/Autokratoria the high.
title_ladder.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH (or an approved commonly-known foreign term where set in 'ruler' - here Archon for the county). The *_native conlang forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.

people_name_convention.order: personal + patronymic (-ides) + polis/deme demonym; often just personal + patronymic.
people_name_convention.dual_register: citizens use personal + patronymic + deme; the renowned earn a descriptive epithet (ho Megas).
people_name_convention.theophoric: names from the morphed deity-names (e.g. Tulrio-, Numeno-, Orlandro-).

religion._note: Deity-names are phoneme-morphs of the canonical (Agrippan) pantheon through Hellenic phonology (-os/-on/-es; th/ph/kh) - recognizably the same powers, never real Greek gods.
religion.the_one: Aiternos (< Aeternus; the One, unknowable source, honored not petitioned)

worship_by_alignment.Lawful: venerates the Lawful powers - Aiternos honored above all, Tulrios the just, Orlandros of the sworn oath, Numenos of wisdom - upholding the laws of the polis and the temenos; names the Chaotic powers daimones (demons), warded.
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: the ancestral heroes (the Heroes of the founding house, venerated at the heroon) and the city-daimones of hearth and harbor; the great powers invoked at the temenos situationally.
worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: Venerates the Chaotic powers of the canon, and names the Lawful powers - and Aiternos - as the tyrant-gods to be defied.

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: each opposing power keeps its morphed name + a portfolio epithet (the suffix -daimon may mark a demon), distinct per power: Maraxus -> Maraxos the Tyrant-Flame; Dementus -> Dementhos the Mad; Desoria -> Desorios the Drowner.
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Mysteria/Temenos of [power]: 'the Mysteries of Numenos'.
religion.saints_pattern: Heros [name] (deified hero/founder), venerated at a heroon (tomb-shrine).

holy_symbol_motifs.Tulrios: radiate sun above olive-branch and scales
holy_symbol_motifs.Orlandros: iron spear crossed with an oath-ring

banks_patterns.ships: feminine -is, virtue & sea names: 'Nike', 'Thalassa', 'Pride of Hellaspol'
